description: This Java source file defines the class TenantServiceBasedX509Authentication, which provides functionality for validating X.509 client certificates by fetching tenant-specific trust anchors from a Tenant service. It includes methods for certificate path validation, tenant lookup, and constructing authentication details for verified clients.

classes.name: TenantServiceBasedX509Authentication
classes.description: Provides validation of client X.509 certificates against tenant-specific trust anchors obtained from a Tenant service. Handles certificate path validation, tenant lookup, and crafts authentication info.

methods.name: validateClientCertificate
methods.description: Validates a given certificate path against trust anchors retrieved from the Tenant service, returning JSON with subject DN and tenant ID upon success.

methods.name: getTenant
methods.description: Retrieves tenant information based on the issuer DN of the client certificate.

methods.name: getX509CertificatePath
methods.description: Converts a generic Certificate array to a list of X509Certificates, failing if unsupported certificate types are present.

methods.name: getCredentials
methods.description: Constructs a JSON object containing the subject DN and tenant ID from the validated client certificate and tenant info.
